title: Simrith Luhaj
kicker: A coy, intelligent, flirtatious giant with an old burn scar and a stated ambition to train a Phoenix.
hook: A coy, intelligent, flirtatious giant with an old burn scar and a stated ambition to train a Phoenix.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A giant fire-falcon trainer stands in ember light with black curls, ash-red cloth, burned cheek marks, and a feather lure glowing like a private dare.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Coy danger wrapped around a fierce protectiveness. Carries a burn from stepping between a frightened fire-falcon and the buyer who called it merchandise. Wants to train living fire without letting anyone reduce it to spectacle or a weapon.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A question to ask A local perspective A grounded reason this place matters
